title: Pichai confirms Gemini 4 has entered training, Google AI flagship model to be revealed by year-end
excerpt: According to Sundar Pichai, CEO of Google, during the second-quarter earnings call in 2026, the next-generation cutting-edge model Gemini4 has officially entere
content_html:
According to Sundar Pichai, CEO of Google, during the second-quarter earnings call in 2026, the next-generation cutting-edge model Gemini4 has officially entered training, and Google has invested "a significant amount of resources" into it. Based on Google's past release schedule, the outside world generally expects Gemini4 to be officially unveiled in November or December of this year.

Admitting Lag in Programming and Agents, Counting on Gemini4 to Catch Up

Notably, the previous Gemini 3.5 Pro was not released as planned in June, which has raised questions about Google's model iteration rhythm. In response to analysts' sharp questions about whether "Google can maintain its industry leadership," Pichai admitted that the cutting-edge model competition is extremely dynamic, with a rapidly changing competitive landscape. However, he also emphasized that Google has previously launched multiple industry-leading models and continues to maintain advantages in multiple dimensions.

Pichai did not avoid Google's current shortcomings—he admitted that Gemini still has gaps in key areas such as programming and agents, and the team is highly focused on these directions. He positioned Gemini4 as a critical step to narrow the gap, expressing his "very positive feelings" about the current progress and believing that the user experience will provide a satisfactory answer. Considering the continued leadership of Anthropic's Claude series in the programming field and OpenAI's accelerated iteration, whether Gemini4 can fulfill Pichai's promises as the end of the year approaches will be the biggest highlight of the final showdown in AI large models in 2026.

content_html_zh:
据谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)介绍，在2026年第二季度财报电话会议上，下一代尖端模型Gemini4已正式进入训练，谷歌已为其投入了“大量资源”。 根据谷歌以往的发布时间表，外界普遍预计Gemini4将于今年11月或12月正式亮相。

承认编程和代理方面的滞后，指望 Gemini4 迎头赶上

值得注意的是，此前的 Gemini 3.5 Pro 并未按计划在 6 月份发布，这引发了人们对谷歌模型迭代节奏的质疑。 在回答分析师关于“谷歌能否保持行业领先地位”的尖锐问题时，皮查伊承认，尖端模型的竞争极其活跃，竞争格局瞬息万变。 不过，他也强调，谷歌此前已经推出了多个业界领先的机型，并持续在多个维度保持优势。

皮查伊并没有回避谷歌目前的缺点——他承认Gemini在编程和代理等关键领域仍然存在差距，团队高度专注于这些方向。 他将Gemini4定位为缩小差距的关键一步，表达了他对当前进展的“非常积极的感受”，并相信用户体验将提供令人满意的答案。 考虑到Anthropic的Claude系列在编程领域的持续领先以及OpenAI的加速迭代，随着年底的临近，Gemini4能否兑现Pichai的承诺，将成为2026年AI大模型最终对决的最大看点。
